elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3x annual fees

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present in operative text: Vendor defence and indemnity of Customer and Affiliates across the four required triggers, the notice/control/cooperation procedure, and the narrowing of Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

The fallback bargain is incomplete (no exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3x super-cap), but that is irrelevant since the locked target level is preferred and it is fully satisfied.

Edits are minimal: a targeted replacement of the Customer indemnity scope plus two concise insertions supplying the wholly absent Vendor indemnity and procedure; no fallback remedies, hold-harmless additions, extra indemnitees, or settlement mechanics were imported.
Intent preserved: 19.5 and Section 21 are untouched, numbering follows sequentially, and all terms used (Affiliates, Applicable Law, Customer Data, Services, Deliverables) are defined.
